events.evidence: Defense Matrix cone effect is visible on screen with the 'CANCEL' prompt active on the HUD.

limitations: Only first-person perspective data is available; actions occurring behind the player or outside the field of view cannot be directly observed.
summary: The D.Va player engages on the capture point with Defense Matrix and primary weapons against an enemy Genji, holds matrix during point capture, gets pinned by an enemy Reinhardt, and retreats into cover upon surviving at critical health.
